channel.title: STATUS KAY Blog (English)
channel.description: Hair, nail and Ljubljana tips from STATUS KAY, a boutique hair salon in Ljubljana.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description: Booking, cancellations, payment and what to expect at your first visit — answered in one place.
item.content:encoded: A few questions come up more than any other, so we've put the answers in one place. If you can't find what you're looking for here, just call or message us — we're happy to help.

item.title: Hot Mama Summer: Getting A Haircut With A Newborn? Completely Normal
item.description: If you have a newborn at home and you're wondering how a salon visit could possibly work right now — here's why it's easier than you think.
item.content:encoded: If you have a small baby at home and you're thinking about booking a haircut or a colour refresh, the same question usually comes up: what do I do with the baby during the appointment, and how do I manage feeding or naps? Our answer is simple — bring them along.

item.title: Where To Go In Ljubljana This Summer After Your Haircut
item.description: A fresh cut changes more than your look — here's how to make the most of the rest of your day in Ljubljana.
item.content:encoded: A fresh haircut changes more than your look — it tends to change your whole afternoon. Once you step out of the studio, Ljubljana's city centre is small enough that almost everywhere worth seeing is within a short walk.

item.title: Why Your Hair Smells Bad
item.description: Sebum, sweat, pollution, and poor-quality products are often to blame for unpleasant hair odor. Discover how a healthy scalp and the right technique can help your hair smell fresh again.
item.content:encoded: Nothing kills your confidence faster than hair that doesn't smell fresh. You just did it, maybe even styled it, and yet something's still off. So what's going on?

item.title: How to Make Your Blowout Last Longer
item.description: A good blowout should last three to five days if you take care of it the right way. Discover simple tricks for keeping your volume, freshness, and smoothness for longer.
item.content:encoded: You know that feeling when you leave the salon with hair that's smooth and full of volume? Then, just a few days later, it suddenly goes flat, staticky, or greasy. The truth is, a good blowout should last at least three to five days if you take care of it the right way.

item.title: How to Speed Up Hair Growth
item.description: Hair growth doesn't come from a miracle product, it comes from the right habits. Discover what actually helps your hair grow longer and stay stronger between salon visits.
item.content:encoded: If you've been looking at your hair lately thinking "why isn't this growing at all?", you're not alone. A lot of our clients in Ljubljana come to us feeling like their hair is damaged, breaking, or simply not making progress. The truth is, hair growth doesn't depend on one "miracle" product, it depends on the right habits (and avoiding the wrong ones).

item.title: How to Get to Our Salon
item.description: Status Kay is located right in the heart of Ljubljana, across the street from the main train station and 100 m from the main bus station. Discover how easy it is to reach us, wherever you're coming from.
item.content:encoded: When choosing a hairdresser, a convenient location matters almost as much as great results. The more accessible the salon, the easier it is to keep up with a fresh, polished, healthy look. That's exactly why Status Kay is located right in the heart of Ljubljana.

item.title: Spring Hairstyles for Busy Working Women
item.description: Simple, low-maintenance spring hairstyles and colors that look polished without extra time or stress. Discover this season's top trends for busy working women.
item.content:encoded: Spring is the perfect time for a fresh start, and that goes for your hair too. But if your schedule is packed with work, social commitments, and everyday tasks, the last thing you want is a hairstyle that takes ages to style. The good news is that there are simple spring hairstyles that will have you looking polished and confident without any extra stress.

item.title: Why You Should Never Peel Polish Off Your Nails
item.description: Peeling off gel polish might seem harmless, but it actually damages your natural nail and weakens it for weeks. Discover why proper polish removal matters so much.
item.content:encoded: Have you ever started peeling gel polish or long-lasting polish off your nails once it began lifting? It looks harmless, but you're actually doing a lot of damage to your natural nails.

item.title: How to Keep Your Nails Strong Between Salon Visits
item.description: Beautiful nails matter beyond just your salon day. Discover simple daily habits that keep your nails strong, hydrated, and polished between appointments.
item.content:encoded: Beautiful, strong nails matter not just on the day you leave the salon, but in the weeks that follow too. For modern, style-conscious clients who want to always look polished and confident, proper nail care between visits is key to a long-lasting, flawless look.

item.title: The Most Common Hair Care Mistakes
item.description: From the wrong shampoo to overusing dry shampoo, discover the most common mistakes that damage your hair, and how we avoid them at Status Kay.
item.content:encoded: As professional stylists, we keep seeing the same hair care mistakes over and over. They're usually the result of poor salon treatments, generic advice, or using products that simply don't suit the individual. Beautiful, healthy hair isn't the result of trends or quick fixes, it comes from understanding what your hair actually needs.

item.title: How Your Hair Affects Your Confidence
item.description: A good hair day changes more than what you see in the mirror; it shapes how you walk, talk, and feel all day long. Discover why hair care is really an investment in yourself.
item.content:encoded: Have you ever noticed how you carry yourself on a good hair day? Your shoulders sit a little straighter, you catch your reflection in a shop window without wincing, you walk into a room with confidence. And then there are the days when your hair is dry, shapeless, and lifeless.

item.title: What to Ask Your Stylist Before They Start
item.description: Before the scissors even come out, there are a few questions that reveal whether your stylist is really the right fit for you. Here's what to ask, and why it matters.
item.content:encoded: You're sitting in the chair. The cape around your neck. Your hair damp. That unmistakable salon smell in the air. And right before the scissors come out, a thought crosses your mind: I hope this person actually knows what they're doing.

item.title: Restore Your Tired Hair
item.description: A whole year of heat and hurry leaves its mark. Discover what a real reset for tired hair actually looks like, and why patience matters most.
item.content:encoded: Your hair didn't turn dull, dry, and lifeless overnight.

item.title: New Year, New Hair
item.description: January is reset season. Discover why a new hairstyle is about more than just a new look, and how Status Kay approaches every transformation.
item.content:encoded: It's January. You're standing in front of the mirror looking at your hair, tired and dry. Like it's still stuck in last year. And the thought creeps into your head, even if you don't say it out loud yet.

item.title: Why Hair Color Fades Too Fast
item.description: Color should last at least 6 to 8 weeks, but often fades sooner. Discover the most common reasons why, and how Status Kay makes sure your color stays put.
item.content:encoded: You walk out of the salon feeling confident. The color is rich, glossy, and perfect.

item.title: Christmas Hair
item.description: December brings dinners, photos, and festive energy. Discover which hairstyles are this year's go-to choice for your Christmas look.
item.content:encoded: December has its own scent. Cinnamon in the air. Cold hands wrapped around warm glasses. Long dinners where photos get taken whether you're ready or not.

item.title: How to Care for Your Hair After a Night Out
item.description: Late nights, alcohol, and tight hairstyles all leave their mark on your hair. Here are five steps to get it back in shape.
item.content:encoded: You know that morning after a long night. Your makeup's half gone. Your head hurts. And your hair feels dry, rough, and lifeless.

item.title: Holiday Hairstyles at Status Kay
item.description: December in Ljubljana brings festive energy and the urge to finally look your best. Discover this season's holiday trends and why Status Kay makes the difference.
item.content:encoded: Ljubljana has its own special charm in winter.

item.title: How to Repair Hair Damaged by Straightening
item.description: Dry, brittle hair from too much flat-ironing? Learn how real repair works from the inside out, and what you can do at home.
item.content:encoded: If your hair is dry, rough, or breaking just from combing it, you're most likely dealing with heat damage. Flat-ironing pulls moisture out of the hair, lifts the cuticle, and weakens the inner structure. Over time this leads to static, breakage, dull color, and split ends that just keep creeping further up the strand.
